# Repair pinned CLI validation

## Parent

- Request: `synthetic/Requests/Repair/repair.md`
- Design: [[../Docs/agentmesh-request-operations-v1]]
- Roadmap: [[../ROADMAP]]

## What to build

Add a fixture-driven Markdown normalization App without Multica domain types.

Problem evidence: Markdown tools currently need orchestrator-specific glue and duplicate parsing.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Manifest validates through pinned CLI.
- [ ] Fixtures produce deterministic output.
- [ ] Run relevant AgentMesh fmt, clippy, and tests; include exact evidence in the PR.
- [ ] Keep release/tag/assets and Multica authority changes out of this PR.

## Blocked by

- None - can start immediately.

## User stories covered

- As a tool author, I can invoke one pinned Markdown App from different orchestrators.

## Notes

- Request kind: `repair`
- Same scope: `agentmesh:repair:pinned-cli-validation`
- AgentMesh CLI use is issue-scoped product verification only; do not mutate Multica through AgentMesh.
- Release/publish, secrets, permissions, production actions, and authority cutover remain human-owned.
